# CarterPierce

> > A visual artist's portfolio exploring dystopian themes, surveillance states, and personal narratives through gouache, illustration, and mixed media.

Carter Pierce's WordPress-hosted art blog features the "Dystopia: The Botanical Garden" series examining panopticon surveillance through terrarium imagery, the "Future Vacation" series, and various illustrated visual journals mixing political commentary with personal storytelling.

## Key Topics

- Dystopia series
- Botanical Garden
- Panopticon surveillance
- Gouache painting
- Visual journal
- Illustration techniques
- Future Vacation series
- Political portraits
- Contemporary art
- Surveillance state themes
- Glass imagery
- Mixed media
- Narrative illustration
- Timeshare Grove

## Core Pages

- [CarterPierce | Painting, Illustrations and Semi-Coherent Thoughts](https://carterpierce.wordpress.com): Homepage featuring Future Vacation series and Dystopian Botanical Garden work
- [About | CarterPierce](https://carterpierce.wordpress.com/about): Artist biography and portfolio overview

## Dystopia: The Botanical Garden Series

- [Dystopia: The Botanical Garden (3/7)](https://carterpierce.wordpress.com/2014/07/25/dystopia-the-botanical-garden-37): Part 3 of Dystopia series exploring surveillance state via terrarium imagery
- [Dystopia: The Botanical Garden (4/7)](https://carterpierce.wordpress.com/2014/07/26/dystopia-the-botanical-garden-47): Part 4 of Dystopia series: underground drug dystopia with purple palette

## Illustration & Visual Journals

- [Narrative Tryptic](https://carterpierce.wordpress.com/2012/10/17/narrative-tryptic): Weekend Worshipper: illustrated personal narrative about Christian camp
- [Visual Journal: Broken Narrative](https://carterpierce.wordpress.com/2012/11/10/visual-journal-broken-narrative): Scratchboard illustration exploring broken narrative and non-linear format
- [Lavender Town, Illustration](https://carterpierce.wordpress.com/2013/09/08/lavender-town-illustration): First-gen Pokemon fan art celebrating Lavender Town nostalgia

## Optional

- [Portraits & Politics; Drawings](https://carterpierce.wordpress.com/2011/12/23/portraits-politics-drawings): Political portrait drawings collection
- [No where, Now here](https://carterpierce.wordpress.com/2012/09/18/no-where-now-here): Visual journal entry exploring nowhere/now here wordplay with symbols
- [Sketchbook Pages](https://carterpierce.wordpress.com/2014/08/16/608): Sketchbook pages mixing observational and imagined mixed-media imagery
